verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents its own account-locking capability that blocks activity during an investigation or remediation, which covers the freeze element of the story. Card suspension is a related card-level control. The Card Auth Loop is a developer building block for custom accept/reject logic, not native limits, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: native per-account and per-program transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, documented reinstatement/unlock paths, program-level control configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths

citations.quote: it may become necessary to lock a customer's account to block certain activity while an investigation or remediation takes place.
